polish.title: Zippy Boy Embroidered Hat
polish.description: This is our little chickadee in a helmet, punched into the panel one stitch at a time. No cheap heat-press junk that peels in the wash bay. Snap it on, crack the windows, and go bang third til the tires cry uncle. Have Fun. Shift Hard.

polish.title: The Chirp'n3rd Sticker Sheet
polish.description: A full sheet of Chirp'n3rd goods — the helmet chickadee, the chirp gags, and a couple you'll fight your buddy over. Slap 'em on your toolbox, your laptop, the inside of your hood. Weatherproof enough to survive a track day and a car wash you shouldn't have paid for.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd Garage Flag
polish.description: Big ol' wall flag for the garage, the paddock tent, or the dorm room you're pretending is a garage. Helmet bird front and center so everybody knows whose bay this is. Grommets in the corners, loud enough to see from across the pits.

polish.title: The Chirp'n3rd Dad Hat
polish.description: Unstructured six-panel with a bent brim you'll ruin perfectly in a week. Little helmet bird stitched on the front, curved bill, that soft crown that sits right after a long day in the bay. Wear it to Cars and Coffee, wear it to change your oil, wear it because your real hair situation is between you and God.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd Snapback
polish.description: Structured snapback, flat brim, keep the sticker on if that's your religion. Helmet bird up front, adjustable snap out back so it fits your buddy's giant head too. Built for the guy who parks nose-out and always has an opinion about your coilovers.

polish.title: The Chirp'n3rd Hoodie
polish.description: Heavyweight pullover for cold-morning cold starts and late-night wrench sessions. Helmet bird on the chest, big front pocket for your knuckles when it's 40 degrees in the garage. Soft enough to nap in the driver's seat while the coolant bleeds. Have Fun. Shift Hard.

polish.title: Scooter Gang Hoodie
polish.description: For the days the project car's on stands and you're ripping around on two wheels instead. Moto-flavored graphic, same helmet bird, same bad decisions. Heavyweight pullover that eats wind on the way to grab parts you didn't budget for.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd Baseball Tee
polish.description: Three-quarter raglan with contrast sleeves and the helmet bird across the chest. Vintage feel, drapes right, hides the fact you've been in the garage since noon. Good for the drive, good for the paddock, good for pretending you'll make it to the batting cage.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd 3/4 Sleeve
polish.description: Three-quarter sleeve raglan for that weird garage weather — too warm for the hoodie, too cold for a plain tee. Helmet bird front and center, contrast sleeves, soft-washed so it feels like you've owned it three summers already.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd Softball 3/4
polish.description: Same three-quarter raglan we love, cut for the beer-league softball crowd who'd rather be at the track. Helmet bird on the chest, roomy through the body, ready for the after-game parking lot meet where everybody pops a hood. Swing hard, shift harder.

polish.title: Keep Yo Lid Warm Beanie
polish.description: Cuffed knit beanie for freezing cold starts and no-heat garages. Little embroidered bird on the fold so your dome reps the brand while your breath fogs up the windshield. Fits under a helmet, over bad hair, through every winter wrench session you swore you wouldn't do.

polish.title: Keep Your Lid Good Beanie
polish.description: The everyday knit beanie — pull it low, keep your lid good through the cold months. Embroidered helmet bird on the cuff, stretchy enough for any head, humble enough to lose in the back seat for a month. Basic in the best way.

polish.title: The Bloomer Trucker
polish.description: Classic foam-front, mesh-back trucker that breathes on hot paddock days. Helmet bird patched up front, snap closure, that perfect bend in the brim after one summer. The one that lives on your headrest and comes out every time somebody says 'let's go for a rip.'

polish.title: CH3RD Plate Tee
polish.description: Clean CH3RD lettering done up like a vanity plate, because that's basically what your car already is. Third gear, tires loose, front and center. Wear it to cars and coffee and let people do the math. Have fun, shift hard.

polish.title: Chirp Mask
polish.description: The helmeted chickadee stares back from a face mask built for garage nights and dusty track days. Half bandit, half bird, all attitude. Good for paint fumes, cold starts, and looking like you mean it.

polish.title: Chirp'N Shift Boltz
polish.description: Little branded bolts for the guy who details the bay before he washes the paint. Bird stamped, weighty, and made to live under the hood where only real ones look. Torque them down and know they're there.

polish.title: Chirpn Crest Tee
polish.description: Old-world crest energy, garage-built values. The chickadee sits dead center flanked by the stuff that actually matters: a manual gate, a helmet, and a redline. Heritage, but the kind that smells like race gas.

polish.title: Chirpn Joggers
polish.description: Soft, cuffed, and stitched with the Chirpn mark down the leg. Built for cold garage mornings and the drive home when the seat's still warm. You will wear these more than any pair of pants you own. That's a promise, not a pitch.

polish.title: Chirp'n Flops
polish.description: Slide-on flops with the bird on the strap for trailer life, pit lane, and the walk to the snack stand. Not track legal, extremely paddock legal. Pair with socks and dare somebody to say something.

polish.title: Chirp'n New New
polish.description: The latest thing out of the garage before we overthink it. Limited, loud, and gone when it's gone. If you're reading this it's probably already moving. Don't sleep.

polish.title: Chirpn Bomber
polish.description: A proper bomber with the bird patched over the heart and something dumb-good stitched on the back. Cold morning starts, night meets, standing around a running engine talking about nothing. This is the jacket for all of it.

polish.title: Chirpn Turd Tee
polish.description: Say Chirp'n3rd fast enough and this is what your buddy hears anyway. So we put it on a shirt. Dumb, proud, and exactly the kind of joke that lives in a group chat at 1am. If you get it, you get it.

polish.title: Chirp'r Badge Sticker
polish.description: Die-cut badge sticker of the bird, sized to sit on a fender, a toolbox, or your laptop. Weatherproof enough to survive a full season and a few car washes you forgot to avoid. Peel, stick, chirp.

polish.title: Chirp'n3rd.com Tee
polish.description: Just the name and the dot-com, big and clean, like an old track tee that accidentally became the whole outfit. It tells people where to find us without you saying a word. Free advertising never fit so good.

polish.title: Big Bird Tee
polish.description: The mascot printed big enough to see from the other end of the paddock. Helmet on, attitude up, taking the whole chest. When you want the bird to do the talking, this is the one.

polish.title: LED Burd Tee
polish.description: Our chickadee redrawn like a late-night sign glowing over a closed shop. Electric outlines, dark background, the kind of print that looks best under parking-lot lights. Same bird, more voltage.

polish.title: OG Burd Tee
polish.description: The original hand-drawn chickadee in a helmet, no gimmicks, just the mark that got two guys in a garage this far. If you own one Chirp'n3rd shirt, it's this one. Where it all started.

polish.title: OG Burd Tee (Blackout)
polish.description: Same original chickadee, flipped to a blackout colorway for the nights you don't want to stand out and somehow still do. If you already own the white one, you know you need this too. The classic, second helping.

polish.title: Gradient Burd Tee
polish.description: The bird washed in a faded gradient that reads like the sky right before a night drive. Softer, a little dreamier, still very much ready to chirp third. For the days you want the mascot without the shout.

polish.title: Burdy Phone Case
polish.description: The chickadee on a case tough enough for oily hands and dropped tailgates. Grippy, printed sharp, and just the right amount of obnoxious when you set it face-up on the workbench. Protects the phone, reps the flock.

polish.title: Chirpn Shift Knob
polish.description: A weighted branded shift knob for the hand that lives on it. Threaded to fit most manuals, heavy enough to feel right on the two-three pull, and stamped with the bird because of course it is. This is where Have Fun, Shift Hard actually happens.

polish.title: Mini Bike Tee
polish.description: Because before the project car there was a mini bike doing 20 and feeling like 200. This one's for the gateway drug that started your whole problem. Send it in the cul-de-sac.

polish.title: Mini Bike Bros Tee
polish.description: For the boys who learned throttle control on a frame-flexing mini bike and never really grew out of it. Two little wheels, one bad idea, lifelong friends. Same energy that fills the garage now, just bigger toys.

polish.title: Better Than a Firebird Tee
polish.description: Import kid trash talk you can wear to the cruise. No shade to the birds with T-tops, but we chirp a different third gear around here. Guaranteed to start at least one argument at the gas pump. That's the point.

polish.title: F40 Roller
polish.description: A rolling shot of the last Ferrari that trusted you completely — no traction control, no safety net, just boost and bad decisions. We're Honda guys at heart but we know a poster-worthy silhouette when we see one. Tape it above the workbench and dream a little.

polish.title: GT3 RS
polish.description: Naturally aspirated, redline in the stratosphere, a rear wing you could serve dinner on. Not our usual driveway build but we respect anything that shows up to the track ready to embarrass everyone. Print it big.

polish.title: BMW Slide
polish.description: Some cars understeer to the wall. This one waves at it sideways. A tribute to the cheapest way to get a car loose and the most expensive way to keep it that way — tires. Wear it, then go feed the habit.

polish.title: Vintage Honda
polish.description: Before turbos got polite and dashboards got screens, Honda built featherweight things that begged for redline. This is a love letter to the era that started the whole chirp habit. VTEC didn't just kick in, it raised us.

polish.title: Classic Nardi
polish.description: A three-spoke wheel that's been bolted into every good build since your grandfather's day. No airbag, no buttons, just a direct line from your hands to the front tires. If you know, you know — and your palms already miss it.

polish.title: Turek Corrola
polish.description: The most reliable econobox ever made, beaten mercilessly by every kid who couldn't afford anything faster — and it just kept running. Yeah we spelled it funny. So did your buddy's dyno sheet. Cheap, light, immortal.

polish.title: Carrera GT
polish.description: Race engine, wooden shift knob, a clutch that separated the brave from the parked. The last hypercar that made you earn it with your left foot. We put a wood knob on our stuff too — theirs just came with 600 horses behind it. Wall material.

polish.title: Huracan Evo Roller
polish.description: A screaming V10 wedge caught mid-roll, doing the one thing it was built to do — make everyone look. Not exactly a garage-build hero but it earns its spot on the wall next to the ones we actually wrench on. Print, hang, admire.

polish.title: NSX
polish.description: Honda took notes from Senna, built a mid-engine legend you could daily, and quietly humbled a paddock full of Italians. This is the one that proves import guys were right all along. Wear it like the flex it is.

polish.title: Rockin for Falken
polish.description: Every sideways hero flies the tire-brand flag, so here's ours. A nod to the blue-and-red sidewalls that die a heroic death every weekend so you can look cool for eleven seconds. Buy the shirt, then buy the tires. Again.

polish.title: Double Stanged
polish.description: For the crew who aired out, tucked tire, and rubbed fender at every driveway. Function optional, fitment mandatory. If your alignment guy sighs when you pull in, this one's for you. Slammed and proud.

polish.title: Period Correct
polish.description: The purist's badge — every part right for the year, nothing anachronistic bolted on to cheat. For the builder who'd rather hunt a swap meet for six months than run a repro. Correct down to the valve stem caps.

polish.title: What Is This Thing Even?
polish.description: The universal question asked over every parts-bin gremlin, orphan connector, and rattling bracket nobody remembers installing. If you've held up a rusty part and squinted, congrats, you're one of us. Wear the confusion proudly.

polish.title: Hell Kitty
polish.description: The import scene's favorite mascot, but she's been to the track and she's angry about the tire prices. Slap her on the window, the toolbox, or the pizza box lid. Peel, stick, misbehave.

polish.title: Ridin Dirty
polish.description: For the daily that never sees a wash bay because there's always a mod to finish first. Fenders full of road grime, trunk full of tools, and zero shame about any of it. Clean car, dirty conscience — nah, other way around.

polish.title: Take No Responsibility
polish.description: When the back end steps out and somebody asks who chirped it into 3rd through the neighborhood, you saw nothing. This one's for the guy who builds the car, sends it, and blames physics. Have fun, shift hard, admit nothing.

polish.title: Don't Blame Me
polish.description: Second gear, third gear, and a decision or two you'd rather not explain to your insurance guy. Slap this on and let the tires take the heat. Two guys in a garage approve this message.

polish.title: Wide Open Or Die
polish.description: There's no half-send here. Foot flat, ears ringing, chickadee riding shotgun in the helmet. Wide open throttle is the only setting we ship. Have fun. Shift hard.

polish.title: Win Or Die
polish.description: Race day math is simple: you either take the win home or you take the walk of shame back to the trailer. This one's for the crew that treats a Tuesday grudge run like the last lap at the 'ring. Send it or sit down.

polish.title: Winning Is Everything
polish.description: We didn't wrench until 3am to come in second. Bolt-on this attitude and go collect. It's not the only thing, it's everything.

polish.title: Winning Is Everything - Sticker
polish.description: Small vinyl reminder for the roll cage, the laptop, or the cooler you keep in the paddock. Winning is everything and now it's peel-and-stick. Weatherproof enough for track days.

polish.title: Winning Crew
polish.description: You don't chirp 3rd alone, you do it with the crew that helped you bleed the brakes at midnight. This one reps the whole pit, not just the driver. Bring the whole garage.

polish.title: Crew!
polish.description: The people who answer the 'can you come hold a flashlight' text at 11pm. That's the crew. Wear it loud. No crew, no chirp.

polish.title: Bad Life Decisions
polish.description: Every good project car started as a bad life decision and got worse from there. Boost leaks, budget leaks, and zero regrets. If you know, you know, and your wallet knows.

polish.title: OG Motorsports
polish.description: For the ones who were bleeding knuckles on import builds before it was a hashtag. Old-guard motorsports, hand-drawn bird, no gatekeeping, just respect. Have fun, shift hard, remember where it started.

polish.title: Truck It, Bro!
polish.description: Sometimes the answer isn't finesse, it's send it and figure out the alignment later. Automotive send-it energy with a straight face. Bro-approved, tire-not-approved.

polish.title: Badge It, Bro
polish.description: Some guys shave every emblem off. You? You add more. Badges on badges, stanced and proud, chickadee in the corner. It's a car-guy inside joke and you're on the inside.

polish.title: You Are A N3rd
polish.description: Yeah, you know your spool from your VE table and you'd rather read a boost log than a menu. Chirp'n3rd was built by n3rds who love the stupid loud stuff. Wear the label. The 3 is on purpose.
